column1: How do you feel about our relationship? (Cordial to Companion)
"I trust you. There aren't many people I would say that about."
column2: "I've always tried to look for the best in people. It's good to find it every now and then."
column3: "We make a great team, and I trust you with my life. What more is there to say?"
column4: "I'm glad we met. Together, there's no challenge we can't overcome and no foe we can't defeat."

column1: "You're affable enough. Just be honest with me and we'll get along fine."
column2: "You're good company. I feel like we see things the same way."
column3: "I count myself lucky that Tenarei Vels knocked me out and left me tied up outside Deepscorn Hollow. I've had no truer friend in my life."
column4: "Life was made for good friends and great adventures."

column1: "I like that you're a listener. So many people like to hear themselves talk."
column2: "You don't often find a traveling companion you can trust your life to. I'm glad we met."
column3: "Until I met you my life was tedious and uneventful. But now I feel the inexplicable need to endanger myself. Isn't that strange?"
column4: "I have never met someone braver or more true. I'm proud to call you friend."

column1: Let's talk about something else. (Returns to Greetings)
